privateDeals.what: Griffin and Goldman Properties bought the 545Wyn office building in Miami's Wynwood district (~298,000 sq ft office) from Sterling Bay for ~$180M; later landed ~$118M financing (Mar 2026).

Citadel committed ~$4.5B as 60% partner with Vornado (lead) to redevelop 350 Park Avenue, Manhattan, into a ~1,414-ft Foster + Partners supertall; Citadel to anchor ~1M sq ft; demolition underway July 2026; ~$3.3B construction loan reported near as of Aug 2026.
City of Miami approved land sale giving Griffin ownership of an entire Brickell block for the planned Citadel HQ (per Forbes headline).
Agreed to sell a Palm Beach property to TZ Capital for ~$81M.
